correctness.rationale: The Lindblad normalization makes hub-leaf coherence decay at s=(kappa+gamma_L+gamma_H)/2. Averaging the localized leaf by permutation covariance preserves the trace survival function. Integrating a’=-kappa a-2mJv, b’=2Jv, d’=2Jv-gamma_L d, v’=-J(b+(m-1)d-a)-sv with a(0)=d(0)=v(0)=0, b(0)=1/m yields A=1/kappa, V=-1/(2mJ), D=-1/(m gamma_L), B=1/kappa+(m-1)/(m gamma_L)+s/(2mJ^2), hence the formula. Positive leaf noise destroys every trace-preserving invariant leaf block: positivity with hub population zero forces R 1=0 and the dephased off-diagonal decay then forces the diagonal to zero. This establishes exponential absorption in finite dimension and legitimizes integration. Separate strict AM-GM inequalities give the unique joint optimum; the dark subspace perpendicular to the uniform leaf vector has initial squared weight 1-1/m when gamma_L=0, proving the discontinuity. Independent full unsymmetrized Liouvillian resolvent checks: 12 m/rate cases, error <=6.3e-15. No finite calculation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The physically natural competition between noise unlocking a dark subspace and excessive noise slowing transport is resolved by an exact all-size, all-positive-rate absorption law. The sharp global three-rate optimum and singular zero-noise boundary provide independent structural facts useful for transport design; these are not simple renamed rate constants.
residual_risks: Scope-specific result; not a claim of a general-graph/general-system theorem.

final_claim: For m>=2, J,kappa,gamma_L>0 and gamma_H>=0 with localized leaf initial state and local projector Lindblad noise, tau=(m+1)/kappa+(m-1)/gamma_L+(kappa+gamma_L+gamma_H)/(4J^2); unique optimizer kappa=2J sqrt(m+1), gamma_L=2J sqrt(m-1), gamma_H=0; at gamma_L=0 absorption probability 1/m.
limitations: An unindexed specialized Haken–Strobl first-passage calculation may give an equivalent star-law after a different symmetry reduction.
